module: Cisco Network Convergence System 1001 Cryptographic Module
caveat: When operated in FIPS mode and with the tamper evident seals installed as indicated in the Security Policy
description: The Cisco NCS 1000 Series offers three chassis variants to meet varying scale and space requirements. This Cisco« Network Convergence System (NCS) Family of products provides an Evolved Programmable Network (EPN) which simplify network operations, reduce network costs, and make your network more dynamic and profitable. The Cisco Network Convergence System 1000 Series (NCS1000 Series) delivers agility, programmability, and massive scale across ultra-long-haul, metro, and enterprise optical networks.
allowed_algorithms: Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #C910, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 112 and 150 bits of encryption strength); EC Diffie-Hellman (CVL Cert. #C910, key agreement; key establishment methodology provides between 128 and 256 bits of encryption strength); NDRNG; RSA (key wrapping; key establishment methodology provides 112 bits of encryption strength)
hardware_versions: NCS1001-K9=, NCS1K-CNTLR2, NCS1K-EDFA, NCS1K-PSM and NCS1K-OTDR with FIPS Kit (AIR-AP-FIPSKIT=)
